13 段抽取流水线：程序做定位，模型做语义；先用程序检查，再由模型独立审核；写零: 13-stage extraction pipeline: code locates, the model judges meaning; code checks first, then an independent model review; writing zero rows is an error.
十三段抽取：程序做定位，模型做语义；先用程序检查，再由模型独立审核。: Thirteen stages of extraction: code locates, the model judges meaning; code checks first, then an independent model review.
程序负责所有能机械确定的事：序号、时间、谁说的、工具调用、提到了谁、去重、出处。: Code handles everything that can be settled mechanically: ordinals, timestamps, who spoke, tool calls, who was mentioned, dedupe, provenance. The model makes semantic judgements only, one at a time, and its output carries only
与逐字引文—— 不给 id，不给时间戳，不给指针，也不给「我有多确定」。: and a verbatim quote — no id, no timestamp, no pointer, and no "how sure I am".
转换器把会话写进统一格式；字段不认识就拒收，秘密先扫一遍。: The converter writes sessions into one format; unknown fields are rejected and secrets are scanned first.
一次一批，可以重跑；这一批失败就停在这，下次从断开的地方接着来。: One batch per pass, and it can be re-run; a failed batch stops there and the next run resumes from the break.
序号、时间、谁说的由程序给；模型只判语义；程序能查的先查，模型审核后到。: Code supplies ordinals, timestamps and speakers; the model only judges meaning. Whatever code can check is checked first, and model review comes after.
召回给一句话简报，搜索给原话，会话给上下文；都能按行首编号展开原文。: Recall gives a one-sentence brief, search gives the raw words, a session gives context; all of them expand the source text by the handle at the start of the line.
导入时每一轮就写进全文索引：会话清单、原话搜索、原文回放照常出结果，不调用模型。: Every turn is written into the full-text index at import: session lists, raw-word search and replay all return results without calling a model.
记忆卡、审核、常驻简报要等模型；模型不在，原文也不会丢，回来再补。: Memory cards, review and the always-on brief wait for the model; without it no raw text is lost, and it is filled in when the model comes back.

菱形是一个个步骤：铜色交给模型，钢蓝由程序执行；两种颜色交替的地方，就是交接。: Each diamond is one step: brass goes to the model, steel blue runs in code; wherever the two colours alternate, there is a handoff.
